name: Continuous-Wave ToF Phasor Model
definition: Extending the volume rendering integral to model images captured with a C-ToF camera by incorporating a path length importance function W(d) to weight contributions based on light travel distance.
summary: The Continuous-Wave ToF Phasor Model simulates C-ToF camera images by weighting volume rendering with complex phasor values, avoiding wrap-around ambiguities and handling multi-path interference more robustly than depth-map methods.
